user_impact: An attorney clicks the only recovery CTA and lands back on My Matters with no explanation. There is no path to fix it or request help.

title: 'Connect Calendar' requests mailbox read/send and full file access
detail: The button reads 'Connect Calendar', with the title 'Connect your calendar to sync events'. It redirects straight away (CalendarPage.jsx:778-781) to intent=user, which requests MICROSOFT_USER_SCOPES 'offline_access User.Read Mail.Read Mail.Send Files.ReadWrite.All Calendars.ReadWrite', or on Google gmail.readonly, gmail.send, calendar and drive (backend/app/routers/integrations.py:256-265). No explainer is shown before consent.
user_impact: Users approve mailbox read/send and all-files access thinking they are only syncing a calendar. That is a transparency and trust problem, and firm privacy reviewers may object.

title: No per-user disconnect for personal Microsoft/Google connections
detail: The Microsoft and Google disconnect endpoints are admin-only. They delete every user's UserOAuthToken for the tenant. Zoom, by contrast, lets each user disconnect their own token (integrations.py:2368-2391). There is no frontend control, and api.js exposes only the Zoom/QBO disconnect helpers (api.js:900-914, 2840).
user_impact: An attorney cannot revoke LawHand's delegated Mail.Read, Mail.Send and Files access to their own mailbox and drive. The only lever is an admin action that disconnects the whole firm.

title: Cloud 'connected' is true when any tenant credential exists (e.g. Zoom only)
detail: _build_matter_cloud_files_response returns connected=True if any active TenantCredential exists, including zoom and zoom_phone rows (integrations.py:978, 1183-1185). The frontend then shows a 'Connected' badge (MatterDetailPage.jsx:1279-1283), a 'Cloud' badge on every conversation (MatterDetailPage.jsx:99-103), and 'Cloud context active — AI chats here have access to matter files from your connected OneDrive, SharePoint, and Google Drive' (MatterDetailPage.jsx:1809-1815).
user_impact: Users are told the AI can see matter files in three providers when no storage provider is connected, or only one is. That misleads both what the AI can see and data-exposure expectations.

title: Cloud-file errors shown as 'no files' or 'not connected'
detail: Any fetch error sets {connected:false}, which renders 'No cloud integrations connected'. A backend search exception, such as an expired token, returns {files:[], connected:true} (backend/app/routers/matters.py:259-263), which renders 'No cloud files found matching this matter.' (MatterDetailPage.jsx:1310-1313). MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:407-413 also swallows errors.
user_impact: When a token expires, users see an empty but apparently healthy panel, or a false 'not connected' state. Neither shows a reconnect action.

title: Calendar drag-move always claims the connected calendar was updated
detail: After updateScheduledEvent, the UI always shows 'Moved … and updated the connected calendar.' It ignores the returned sync_status, external_calendar_event_id and calendar_provider, which the PATCH does return (backend/app/routers/calendar.py:481-497). It shows the message for local-only events too. syncMessageForScheduledEvent (line 294) exists but is not reused.
user_impact: When the Outlook/Google write fails or the token has expired, the attorney believes the external calendar moved. Missed appointments are likely.

title: Calendar delete claims external deletion even when the provider call failed
detail: The UI always says 'Event deleted from LawHand and its connected calendar.' The backend's delete_external_event discards the boolean from ms_delete_event/google_delete_event, which return False when there is no token (backend/app/services/scheduled_events.py:125-143, backend/app/services/calendar_sync.py:306-320). The route returns 204 regardless (calendar.py:501-521).
user_impact: Orphaned events stay in Outlook/Google (e.g. a cancelled client meeting) while the UI says they were removed.

title: Cancelling Microsoft/Google sign-in consent shows raw 422 JSON
detail: microsoft_callback and google_callback (auth.py:1572-1579) declare code: str and state: str as required, with no error parameter. When the provider redirects with ?error=access_denied or consent_required (response_mode=query), FastAPI's validation raises before the @_redirect_refusals_to_login wrapper (auth.py:1128-1142) can run. There is no RequestValidationError handler in main.py. loginErrors.js has no admin-consent message. The integrations connect callbacks do handle error (integrations.py:512-516).
user_impact: A user who cancels, or whose Entra/Workspace admin blocks user consent, gets a JSON error page rather than a clear 'your admin must approve LawHand' message on /login.

title: Background calendar pull hides token failures
detail: The 5-minute pullProviderChanges catches every error and does nothing. The comment defers to the explicit sync. No last-synced time is kept.
user_impact: If the token expires mid-session, stale Outlook/Google events stay on screen with no warning until the user clicks Sync.

title: Document Open links use stored web URL instead of the backend /open resolver
detail: Links at lines 1140, 1280 and 1406 use doc.cloud_url, the persisted storage_path. The backend has /matters/{m}/documents/{d}/open, which 'resolves a fresh tenant-provider editing URL from durable object IDs' (backend/app/routers/matter_documents.py:719-747). ActionProposalCard.jsx:584-586 already uses it.
user_impact: After a rename or move in SharePoint/OneDrive, where webUrl is path-based, Open goes to a 404 in the provider.

title: Documents tab repeats the slowest live cloud search
detail: getMatterCloudFiles runs again on tab mount, although MatterDetailPage already ran it after the matter loaded. The comment there calls it 'by far the slowest request' (MatterDetailPage.jsx:569-575). Errors are swallowed.
user_impact: Extra Graph/Drive search load and latency every time the Documents tab opens.

title: Transparency guide is inaccurate and links to missing chapters
detail: The permission lists at lines 39-47 and 63-69 leave out send-mail, although both admin and personal grants request Mail.Send / gmail.send (integrations.py:241-265). Line 119 says documents are 'not copied into a LawHand datastore', but upload falls back to 'Saved locally' (MatterDocumentsTab.jsx:446-449). The related links at lines 125-126 (/guide/documents-and-cloud-files, /guide/calendar-tasks-and-key-dates) match no slug, and GuideViewer silently redirects to chapter 1 (GuideViewer.jsx:95).
user_impact: Users and privacy reviewers get an incomplete picture of what LawHand can do in their mailbox, and the cross-links do not work.

title: Correspondence load failure looks like an empty archive
detail: The .catch(() => setItems([])) renders 'No correspondence captured yet. Configure capture rules, then click Scan now' (lines 683-689).
user_impact: On an API or permission error, the user rescans or reconfigures rules instead of retrying, which risks duplicate work.
